head: e0dbbb006ddfc1755e11305fbf5f0d68d6b59e0a
title: fix(help-links): coach Help centre and Membership link open real pages (HUNT-09-124)
body:
HUNT-09-124 (agent 124), DAY-1 EDGE HUNT: config vs code truth. T1 (two link targets, copy on one button, tests). 136 changed lines.

## What a person hit on production (public GETs, 10-06 ~13:00 PDT)
- B-H09-1: a coach (or the App Store reviewer on the coach account) taps Settings > Help centre and the browser shows a raw JSON `Cannot GET /help/coach` 404. `helpUrl('/coach')` builds `https://app.trygrowthproject.com/help/coach`; the backend serves only `/help`, `/help/setup`, `/help/first-client`, `/help/tour`, `/help/faq`, `/help/support`, `/help/contact`, `/help/delete-account` (backend `src/main.ts` setGlobalPrefix exclude). Broken links in the app are an App Review 2.1 (completeness) risk.
- U-H09-2: an Android client taps More > Membership > "Open trygrowthproject.com" and lands on "Page not available": the bare site root is the custom-domain coach-landing route, which 404s on the canonical host.

## Fix
- `src/screens/coach/SettingsScreen.tsx`: Help centre opens `helpUrl()` (the help centre home, 200; it lists the coach guides).
- `src/screens/client/MembershipScreen.tsx`: the secondary link reads "Contact support" and opens `/help/contact` (200). Still hidden on iOS non-P2P builds (unchanged gate). No overlap with m#402's hunk in this file (explainer copy, lines 165-170).
- `src/config/env.ts`: `HELP_PAGE_PATHS` (the served list) and `HELP_CONTACT_URL`.

## Tests (failing first)
- Commit 229b9eca adds the tests without the screen fix; ci-lane run on that commit is expected red.
- `src/__tests__/hunt09HelpLinks.test.ts`: every `helpUrl('<literal>')` in src is a served help page; no screen opens the bare site root.
- `src/__tests__/membershipWebsiteLinkIos.test.tsx`: Android press opens `/help/contact`.
- `src/navigation/__tests__/coachSettingsMoneyRow.test.tsx`: Help centre press opens the help home, not `/help/coach` (env mock now a function).

Must merge before the 10-07 build to ship in it.
